note: Single source of truth for owner crypto receive addresses that are fanned out into repo secrets. Public receive addresses only — never place a private key or seed here. Consumed by scripts/rotate-crypto-addresses.mjs and by the allowlist inventory scan inside .github/workflows/owner-crypto-withdraw.yml.

depositRoutes.note: Custodial exchange deposit routes (customer incoming payments). These are NOT owner wallets and NOT withdrawal destinations: allowlisting one would send a withdrawal into an exchange deposit address. Verified live against the provider API on verifiedAt — re-verify before ever treating one as stale.

targets.reason: Withdrawal allowlist gate. Must carry every payable destination, canonicalised.
